transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been struggling a lot with staying focused on my tasks and keeping my mind on what I'm doing. It has also been really hard to keep my activities and things organized, so I wanted to get some help with these attention difficulties.
Have these difficulties with focus and organization started recently, or have you struggled with them for as long as you can remember, even back in childhood?

They definitely aren't recent; I've actually struggled with these things since I was a kid, well before I turned 12. It has been a really consistent and frustrating issue for about the last two years and three months.
Along with these focus and organization issues, do you often feel restless, find it hard to sit still, or feel a constant urge to be on the go?
No, I don't really feel restless or find it hard to sit still, and I don't have a constant urge to be on the go. My difficulties are mainly limited to the focus and organization issues I mentioned.
Apart from your focus issues, have you been experiencing a persistently low or depressed mood, or a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?
No, I haven't been experiencing a depressed mood or any loss of interest in the things I enjoy. My struggles are really just centered around my focus and keeping things organized.
Do you find yourself experiencing persistent, excessive worry or anxiety about everyday things that feels difficult to control?

No, I wouldn't say I experience that kind of persistent or uncontrollable worry. I don't really feel anxious about everyday things. My main struggles are really just with my attention and staying organized.
